_doc: Direct artifact-score happy path: POST /api/brand/score-artifact with the license header returns 200 and a deterministic quality score. Exercises the full live chain AuthMiddleware -> fetch -> static seo/accessibility/performance scanners -> pure score aggregation. NO LLM and NO worker seeding are involved, so — unlike icp-contract — this is ungated and goes green as soon as analysis_service is deployed. Asserts stable keys (overall_score, category_scores, source) that are always set on a 200, so a passing scan never flakes on which findings happened to surface.
